title: Use the Sort Confirmation support table to identify missing sort/dimension data (e.g., AIO one) by checking Length/Width/Height/Weight values
summary: Inspect the Sort Confirmation support table/view by filtering to “sort confirmation,” zooming in on the resulting rows, and checking the dimension-related fields (Length/Width/Height/Weight). A notable indicator called out in the source is when Width, Height, and Weight are all “1”; the source uses this pattern to identify that “AIO one” was not sending sort data or dimension data.
when_to_use: Use when you need to determine whether a specific source/package is not sending sort data or dimension data, using the dimension fields shown in the Sort Confirmation support table/view.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the filter/zoom review in the Sort Confirmation support table/view and report the identified package/source row and the observed dimension pattern.
access_or_tools_needed: Access to the sort confirmation support table/view shown in the source frame
Ability to apply the “sort confirmation” filter in that view
Ability to zoom in so the table columns (Length/Width/Height/Weight and related fields) are readable

visual_references.description: Sort confirmation support table/view with columns including Zone, LaneName, PackageUid, TrackingNumber, Length, Width, Height, Weight, Cube, Toteld, Message, PackageClassification, MissingDimensionData, MissingInduct, ToteNotfound, Diverted, OffTheEnd, Recirc; includes the “every width, height and weight was 1” pattern and the AIO one callout.

steps.title: Open the Sort Confirmation support table/view and locate the dimension-related columns
steps.purpose: Establish the correct support table/view and confirm the presence of the dimension-related fields needed to evaluate missing sort/dimension data.
steps.instruction: Open the support table/view shown in the source that displays Sort Confirmation records. Ensure the table includes the dimension-related columns: Length, Width, Height, and Weight (along with other package fields such as Zone, LaneName, PackageUid, TrackingNumber, Cube, Toteld, Message, PackageClassification, MissingDimensionData, MissingInduct, Diverted, OffTheEnd, and Recirc).
steps.expected_result: You can see the Sort Confirmation support table/view with the columns Length, Width, Height, and Weight visible for the displayed rows.
steps.healthy_condition: The table shows the expected column headers including Length, Width, Height, and Weight, and rows are populated with package-level values.
steps.failure_condition: The Sort Confirmation table/view is not visible, or the dimension columns (Length/Width/Height/Weight) are not present/visible.

actions.label: Verify dimension columns are present
actions.exact_action: Open the sort confirmation support table/view shown in the training frame (table includes columns such as Zone, LaneName, PackageUid, TrackingNumber, Length, Width, Height, Weight, Cube, Toteld, Message, PackageClassification, MissingDimensionData, MissingInduct, Diverted, OffTheEnd, Recirc).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the table does not show the dimension-related columns (Length/Width/Height/Weight), stop and escalate for further investigation rather than proceeding.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Speaker: “filtered on sort confirmation” and the table includes columns such as Length, Width, Height, Weight; OCR shows the support table with MissingDimensionData and other fields.

steps.title: Filter the table to show “sort confirmation” records
steps.purpose: Limit the dataset to the records the source uses for the dimension/sort-data review.
steps.instruction: Apply the filter used in the source to focus on “sort confirmation” records in the support table/view.
steps.expected_result: The table is filtered so that the visible rows correspond to “sort confirmation” records.
steps.healthy_condition: The active filter indicates “sort confirmation,” and the resulting rows update accordingly.
steps.failure_condition: No “sort confirmation” filter is applied/available, or the visible rows do not correspond to sort confirmation records.

actions.label: Apply sort confirmation filter
actions.exact_action: Filter on “sort confirmation” within the support table/view.

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot apply the “sort confirmation” filter or the table does not reflect sort confirmation records, stop and escalate for further investigation.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript: “I kind of filtered on sort confirmation …”

steps.title: Zoom in so Length/Width/Height/Weight values are readable
steps.purpose: Enable accurate reading of the dimension fields used to detect the “all 1” pattern.
steps.instruction: Zoom in on the filtered results so the dimension fields (Length, Width, Height, Weight) and the related package/source identifiers are readable.
steps.expected_result: You can clearly read Width, Height, and Weight values for the visible filtered rows.
steps.healthy_condition: The numeric values in Width/Height/Weight are legible for multiple rows under the sort confirmation filter.
steps.failure_condition: The dimension values are not legible (e.g., too small/blurred), preventing verification of whether Width/Height/Weight are “1.”

actions.label: Zoom in on filtered rows
actions.exact_action: Zoom in on the filtered results so the dimension fields are readable.

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot zoom enough to read Width/Height/Weight values, stop and escalate or request assistance to view the table clearly.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript: “you can kind of zoom in, you see …”

steps.title: Check for the “Width/Height/Weight all equal to 1” pattern
steps.purpose: Use the source-highlighted indicator to assess whether dimension data is missing or not being populated correctly.
steps.instruction: On the filtered, zoomed-in rows, verify whether every Width, Height, and Weight value is “1” across the visible results.
steps.expected_result: You observe that Width, Height, and Weight are all “1” for the visible filtered rows (or you observe that this pattern is not present).
steps.healthy_condition: Width, Height, and Weight values are consistently “1” across the visible filtered rows, matching the source’s notable pattern.
steps.failure_condition: Width/Height/Weight are not all “1” (i.e., at least one of Width, Height, or Weight differs from “1” in the visible filtered rows).

actions.label: Verify Width/Height/Weight values
actions.exact_action: Verify whether every Width, Height, and Weight value is “1” across the visible rows.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the “all 1” pattern is not present in the filtered results, stop and escalate for further investigation rather than assuming missing data.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript: “you can see that every width, height and weight was 1.”

steps.title: Identify the specific source/package row (AIO one) associated with missing sort/dimension evidence
steps.purpose: Pinpoint the specific package/source row that the source indicates is not sending sort data or dimension data.
steps.instruction: Within the filtered results, locate the row identified as “AIO one” in the source and confirm it aligns with the missing sort/dimension evidence (the source states AIO one was “not sending sort data or dimension data”).
steps.expected_result: You identify the row/source labeled as “AIO one” in the filtered table and associate it with the missing sort/dimension evidence described by the source.
steps.healthy_condition: The “AIO one” row is visible in the filtered results, and the dimension-related values reflect the missing-data indicator used by the source (Width/Height/Weight all “1”).
steps.failure_condition: You cannot find the “AIO one” row in the filtered results, or the row does not align with the missing sort/dimension evidence pattern.

actions.label: Locate AIO one row
actions.exact_action: Identify the specific source/package row called out in the source (AIO one) and confirm it is associated with the missing sort/dimension evidence.

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot identify the AIO one row in the filtered results, stop and escalate for further investigation.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript: “saw that AIO one was not sending sort data or dimension data.”
Frame evidence for the filtered sort confirmation table showing the dimension columns and the AIO one callout context.

steps.title: Communicate the finding that sort/dimension data is missing for the identified source/package
steps.purpose: Provide actionable feedback based on the observed evidence in the support table.
steps.instruction: Using the observed evidence (the “all 1” dimension pattern and the row identified as AIO one), communicate that sort/dimension data is missing for that source/package.
steps.expected_result: You can clearly state which source/package row (AIO one) is implicated and what observable dimension pattern supports the conclusion (Width/Height/Weight all “1” in the filtered sort confirmation records).
steps.healthy_condition: Your communication references the specific row/source and the observable dimension values/pattern used to support the conclusion.
steps.failure_condition: You communicate a conclusion without referencing the observable dimension pattern and the specific identified row/source.

actions.label: Report missing sort/dimension evidence
actions.exact_action: Use the observed evidence (the “all 1” dimension pattern and the row identified as AIO one) to communicate the finding that sort/dimension data is missing for that source.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the filtered results do not support the “all 1” pattern or the AIO one row cannot be identified, do not communicate missing-data as a conclusion; stop and escalate for further investigation.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript: “I kind of filtered on sort confirmation … every width, height and weight was 1 … saw that AIO one was not sending sort data or dimension data.”

success_criteria: You can point to filtered Sort Confirmation records where Width, Height, and Weight are all “1.”
You identify the specific row/source called out as “AIO one” in the filtered results as the implicated source for missing sort/dimension data.
healthy_conditions: Sort Confirmation filter is applied and visible in the support table/view.
Width, Height, and Weight values are readable after zooming.
The observed dimension pattern matches the source’s indicator (Width/Height/Weight all “1”) for the implicated records.
failure_conditions: The filtered Sort Confirmation view does not show the expected dimension columns/values (Length/Width/Height/Weight).
The “all 1” pattern is not present in the filtered results.
The AIO one row cannot be identified in the filtered results.
escalation_guidance: If the filtered sort confirmation view does not show the expected dimension columns/values or the “all 1” pattern is not present, stop and escalate for further investigation rather than assuming missing data.
If you cannot identify the AIO one row in the filtered results, stop and escalate for further investigation.
